nodes.label: Electricity filter (session-cookie POST)
nodes.rationale: A POST sets a session cookie to filter list pages to Electricity messages; if a list page comes back unfiltered, the filter is re-applied automatically, guarding against session/cookie loss during a long crawl.

nodes.label: Per-row error column
nodes.rationale: Per-message parse/fetch failures are stored in the row's `error` column rather than aborting the crawl, so one bad record doesn't halt backfill/incremental progress.

nodes.norm_label: list page pagination (page n of m)

nodes.label: Backfill crawl mode
nodes.rationale: Walks list pages from next_page to the last page storing every unseen witid, checkpointing progress after each page so an interrupted run resumes where it stopped instead of restarting.

nodes.label: Incremental crawl mode
nodes.rationale: Once backfill has finished, walks from page 1 and stops at the first page with no new messages, avoiding a full re-walk of the site on every run.

nodes.label: LABELS field-name mapping
nodes.rationale: Detail-page dt labels are mapped to snake_case keys via LABELS, fixing the site's own inconsistent spelling of 'Unavailibility'/'Unavailabillity'; unknown labels fall back to a slug so new fields land in `data` instead of being dropped.

nodes.label: Request delay / retry-with-backoff
nodes.rationale: Requests are spaced by REQUEST_DELAY (0.5s) and retried 3x with backoff, to avoid overloading or being blocked by the source site.
